what: The shipped checks/markdownlint.jsonc and its documented command (markdownlint-cli2 --config checks/markdownlint.jsonc) do not work together: markdownlint-cli2 0.18.1 rejects any --config file whose name is not <prefix>.markdownlint.jsonc or a cli2 name. The skill and checks.md name no markdownlint-cli binary either.
tell: Error: Unable to use configuration file ...markdownlint.jsonc; Configuration file should be one of the supported names
proposed_change: Rename the shipped config to a supported name, or document 'markdownlint -c' from markdownlint-cli (accepts any name) and the adopter-override pattern (extends plus MD040 allowed_languages).
evidence: Worked around with markdownlint-cli 0.45.0 and a repo .markdownlint.jsonc that extends the shipped file; checks.md also leaves MD013, MD014 and MD051 on, which fire on one-sentence-per-line Starlight pages with explicit {#id} anchors.
